title.zh: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana
title.en: Mirae Asset Securities issues tokenized notes on Solana

current_state.zh: Mirae Asset Securities' Hong Kong unit issued six-month floating-rate tokenized notes on Solana under its $3 billion structured note program, with Marketnode as authorized distributor, aiming to model blockchain-based distribution of structured products to institutional investors.
current_state.en: Mirae Asset Securities' Hong Kong unit issued six-month floating-rate tokenized notes on Solana under its $3 billion structured note program, with Marketnode as authorized distributor, aiming to model blockchain-based distribution of structured products to institutional investors.
